annotations.title: Get the utility's price to compare

description: Use this when someone asks what their electric utility's default rate is (the 'price to compare' or default service supply rate on the electric bill), or whether a plan's rate beats it. Returns the current rate in cents per kWh, supply only. Do not use it for Texas (Texas has no price to compare), for a whole electric bill (delivery charges are not included), or for past rates (only the current rate is held). `status` `no_data_for_scope` means we hold no rate for that state, never that the utility has none; never invent one.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. 'PA'. Required.

utility.description: Utility name, full or partial: 'Eversource' matches 'Eversource - NSTAR' and 'Eversource - WMECO'. Required.

name: electricity_get_price_to_compare
